1.consolidated_definition: Árbol caducifolio de hasta 25 m de altura, con hojas bipinnadas, flores amarillas en grandes racimos y fruto en vaina; es ornamental. (Fabaceae, Peltophorum pterocarpum).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree that can reach up to 25 meters in height, with bipinnate leaves, yellow flowers in large clusters and fruit in a pod; it is ornamental. (Fabaceae, Peltophorum pterocarpum).
